path_conditions: Caller cpt_device_init() is invoked from cpt_probe(), which is the PCI driver .probe callback (cpt_pci_driver). PCI probe callbacks run in process context and are therefore sleepable. Busy-waiting with mdelay(100) wastes CPU cycles; the sleeping primitive msleep(100) should be used instead. The bug fits the 'delay-gfp' pattern: a busy-wait/atomic-only primitive used where a sleeping equivalent is correct.
